project_name: Evermore - Editorial Wedding Single Page & Interactive Guestbook
design_tone: Cinematic, high-fashion editorial keepsake, intimate, warm ivory and deep wine contrast with floating rose petals
app_type: hybrid landing page with interactive guestbook

font_family_pairing.mono_accent: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace (for live countdown digits & timestamps)

scale.hero_title: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
scale.section_heading: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight text-wine
scale.caption_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-sans font-semibold text-wine/70
scale.countdown_number: text-4xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-mono font-light tracking-tight text-wine

colors.theme_mode: Light Editorial Warmth with Deep Wine Structural Accents

layout_and_spacing.hero_height: min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between pt-24 pb-12

visual_enhancers.floating_petals: Canvas or Framer Motion based ambient rose petals softly drifting and rotating down the screen with CSS pointer-events-none and low opacity (0.75)
visual_enhancers.editorial_marquee: Infinite smooth scrolling ticker with romantic typography ('CELEBRATING ETIENNE & ISABELLE • OCT 24, 2026 • CHÂTEAU DE DE LA COUR •') in low contrast wine text on blush backdrop
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_nav: Fixed top bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF7F2]/80 border-b border-[#4A1525]/10 z-50 transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.polaroid_wish_cards: Masonry wish cards styled like physical high-end wedding polaroids: 1px border border-[#4A1525]/15 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 p-5 bg-white

hero_countdown.behavior: Real-time ticking countdown to target date (Oct 24, 2026 16:00:00). Displaying Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds with smooth digit transition animations. Line-by-line kinetic reveal of couple names on page mount.

guestbook_masonry.behavior: Guests submit name, message, RSVP status, and optional photo upload/preset selector. Instantly inserts into masonry wall of wishes. Admin toggle enables deletion of posts with test-id confirmation.

schedule_and_venue.behavior: Interactive timeline cards detailing Ceremony, Cocktail Reception, Banquet, and Dancing with Google Maps integration link.

instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Ensure React components are implemented as .js / .jsx files as specified in the environment setup.
Implement real-time ticking logic for the live countdown hero timer with initial line-by-line opacity / slide text animations for couple names.
Ensure floating rose petals animation runs smoothly on continuous loop without interfering with text selection or button clicking (pointer-events-none).
Build the guestbook with live state persistence (local storage or backend endpoint) allowing photo attachment and admin delete post functionality.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, action buttons, countdown cells, and guestbook items as listed.
Use generous whitespace (py-24 to py-36) and high-contrast typography in Cormorant Garamond / Plus Jakarta Sans.
